exact: calcium- and calmodulin-dependent protein phosphatase activity

definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein serine/threonine phosphate + H2O = protein serine/threonine + phosphate, dependent on the presence of calcium-bound calmodulin.
label: Calcineurin binds and dephosphorylates NFAT1 in response to WNT/Ca2+ signaling
